newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate closes lower.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate closes lower.

text.p: Taiwan's overnight interbank rate finished lower on Monday as some major banks continued to liquidate excess funds, but dealers expected the rate to rise amid tightening liquidity in the banking system.
The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.137 percent against Saturday's 5.249 close, with 30-day commercial paper stable at 5.25 against 5.20-5.25.
Dealers said routine monthly payroll demand is expected to push up the money rates later in the week.
The government bond yields jumped in late trade, with the 10-year 84/1 bond yield at 5.7025-7100. --Julie Hu (5080815)
